lede: V5 still will not turn clockwise, but it will turn a pillow into a marshmallow.
title: Same seed, two worlds, and a model that prefers the left-hand dutch
rundown:
Wednesday on Anlatan was a style fight with a quiet staff footnote. matts7123 posted a same-seed goblin barbarian walking from clean anime into photoreal and back again — no artist tags, just 1.4::anime:: against 0.6::photorealistic:: — and the thread treated it like a lab note instead of a flex. Meanwhile the room argued that V5 Full has a default-style attractor: artist tags sway less than they did on 4.5, Curated may be easier to pull, and luca confirmed the UI guidance default is 7 (not 3.5). guestavius could not get a clockwise dutch; weighting clockwise made it more counter-clockwise. The working joke-workaround is to put an object in the upper left so the frame has to tip the other way. Inpaint had the day's useful discovery: tagless English in the hole ("There is a huge marshmallow instead of a pillow") is beating tag fights, and a V5 crop sent into 4.5 inpaint wants Focused Area Selection with Minimum Context Area 32. luna (backend) answered the Opus meter in-channel: img2img drain follows Strength, not Noise; inpaint meters on V5 Full; Curated inpaint is still V4.5C; upscale is Anlas, not the battery. Webapp build 70a31dc-production. Contracts unchanged vs the Aug 28 dump. Not updated.

The unofficial server was smaller and meaner. pleasebankai cranked CFG 8 and prompt-guidance rescale to 0.8–1.0 for what they called a crack look. Amber reported plastic limbs below 15 steps. Aryllias described a V4.5 ladder: PR keepers, vibe img2img, PR again for corrections — typed chunks, not a UI preset. kinky and very-kinky were silent. nsfw-generation dumped images with no pasted prompts. No new verified V5 hip, weight-gain, or pregnancy recipes. Those spicy keepers stay off this public billboard.
official: Afternoon after 10:00 ET: 426 official messages, 30 technique. Morning since 8/28: 9,211 pulled / ~949 on-topic (heuristic). V5 needs much less emphasis than V4.5 (rarely >1.5; 5+ still for undertrained tags; same-seed test). Scout 14–18 steps; some stacks lose quality above ~20–23; complex multi-char 23–28. Character-box split anecdote: base = count + style + camera; actions in boxes (action can still bleed). Same-seed set: seed 336020714, 23 steps, 1216×832, scale 7, cfg_rescale 0, karras, k_euler_ancestral.
unofficial: Afternoon: 42 unofficial messages, 12 technique (all nai-image-gen-discussion). Morning since 8/28: 1,082 pulled / ~107 on-topic. CFG 8 + rescale 0.8–1.0. Sub-15 steps artifact. PR then vibe img2img then PR. No new hip/WG/pregnancy recipes.
